Build Grouped Choices for Schema Column Dropdowns

get_schema_choices_grouped.Rd

Builds a named list of named character vectors suitable for selectInput or selectizeInput with optgroups. Columns are grouped by their category from the database or hardcoded config.

Usage

get_schema_choices_grouped(
  column_descriptions,
  schema_columns,
  user_col = NULL
)

Arguments

column_descriptions

Named list of column descriptions (from .get_column_descriptions()). Each element should be a list with at least description and optionally category.

schema_columns

Character vector of all valid schema column names.

user_col

Optional: name of the user column being mapped, used to sort choices within each group by string similarity (most relevant first).

Value

A named list where names are category labels and values are named character vectors of column choices (suitable for selectInput optgroups).
